source.author: ov
source.text: Ille notam fulgore dedit tonitruque secundo.
source.text_original: Ille notam fulgore dedit tonitruque secundo.
source.text_english: He gave the signal with a flash of lightning and a second thunderclap.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Graiaque nunc undis duce te nutuque secundo it ratis?
reuse.text_original: Graiaque nunc undis duce te nutuque secundo / it ratis?
reuse.text_english: And now, under your guidance and with your favoring nod, does the Greek ship go over the waves?
